verdict.rationale: Incident management is a fair question for an observability platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only alerting and notifications: alerts on log patterns, monitoring signals and timely notifications, and AI-assisted alert tuning. Those are adjacent features, and nothing documents declaring incidents, incident timelines, on-call schedules or escalation policies.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can declare and track incidents with timelines, on-call schedules, and escalation policies
